def leap_doy(dates64):
    m = dates64.astype('datetime64[M]').astype(int) % 12 + 1
    day = (dates64 - dates64.astype('datetime64[M]')).astype(int) + 1
    return CUM[m-1] + day
ext_doy = leap_doy(ext_dates)
bl = (ext_dates >= np.datetime64('1992-01-01')) & (ext_dates <= np.datetime64('2002-12-31'))

# pool index table: rows for doy 1..366 excluding 60 -> 365 rows
non60 = [dd for dd in range(1,367) if dd != 60]
pool_idx = np.stack([np.where(M[dd-1])[0] for dd in non60]).astype(np.int32)  # (365,121)
assert pool_idx.shape == (365,121)
print("pool_idx", pool_idx.shape, "min/max rel idx", pool_idx.min(), pool_idx.max())

ext_f = sst_ext.astype(np.float64)      # (4028,60,60) ~116MB
fin_tgt = np.isfinite(sst_tgt)
sea = fin_tgt.all(axis=0)               # (60,60) bool
cells = np.where(sea.ravel())[0]
print("sea cells:", len(cells))

def hazen_q90_sorted(xs_sorted, nf):
    # xs_sorted: (365,121,B) sorted along axis1 with NaN at end; nf: (365,B)
    vi = 0.9*nf.astype(np.float64) - 0.5
    vi_c = np.clip(vi, 0.0, (nf-1).astype(np.float64))
    i0 = np.floor(vi_c).astype(np.int64)
    i1 = np.minimum(i0+1, (nf-1).astype(np.int64))
    frac = vi_c - i0
    tmp = np.take_along_axis(xs_sorted, i0[:,None,:], axis=1)[:,0,:]
    tmp2 = np.take_along_axis(xs_sorted, i1[:,None,:], axis=1)[:,0,:]
    q = tmp + frac*(tmp2-tmp)
    q[nf==0] = np.nan
    return q

# verify hazen implementation vs np.quantile on random data (with NaN)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
ok=True
for _ in range(300):
    n = rng.integers(1,40)
    x = rng.normal(size=n); x[rng.random(n)<0.3]=np.nan
    xf = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    if len(xf)==0: continue
    mine = hazen_q90_sorted(np.sort(x[None,:,None],axis=1), np.array([[np.isfinite(x).sum()]]))[0,0]
    ref = np.quantile(xf, 0.9, method='hazen')
    if not np.isclose(mine, ref, rtol=0, atol=1e-12): ok=False; print("MISMATCH", mine, ref); break
print("hazen impl check vs np.quantile:", "OK" if ok else "FAIL")

B = 64

    cc = cells[s:s+B]
    G = ext_f[:, cc.ravel() // nlon, cc.ravel() % nlon]        # (4028, B)
    P = G[pool_idx]                                            # (365,121,B)
    P.sort(axis=1)
    nf = np.isfinite(P).sum(axis=1)                            # (365,B)
    q = hazen_q90_sorted(P, nf)                                # (365,B)
    mean = np.where(nf>0, np.where(np.isnan(P),0.0,P).sum(axis=1)/np.maximum(nf,1), np.nan)
    doys = np.array(non60) - 1                                 # 0-based rows
    thr_cells[doys, s:s+len(cc)] = q
    clm_cells[doys, s:s+len(cc)] = mean
print("pools+quantiles done in", round(time.time()-t0,1),"s")

    day = (dates64 - dates64.astype('datetime64[M]')).astype(int) + 1
    return CUM[m-1] + day
tgt_doy = leap_doy(tgt_dates)
print("target doys:", tgt_doy[0], "..", tgt_doy[-1], "n=", len(tgt_doy))
assert list(tgt_doy) == list(range(153,245))

# circular 31-day centred moving mean, weights 1/31
K = 31
def circ_smooth(a):  # a: (366, ncells)
    out = np.empty_like(a)
    for off in range(-15, 16):
        out += np.roll(a, off, axis=0)
    out /= K
    return out

t0=time.time()
thr_s = circ_smooth(thr)
clm_s = circ_smooth(clm)
print("smoothing done", round(time.time()-t0,1),"s")
# check circularity: day0 includes doy 352..366 and 1..15
chk = (thr[np.r_[351:366, 0:16]].mean(axis=0))
print("smooth[0] == mean(doy352..366,1..15):", np.allclose(thr_s[0], chk, rtol=0, atol=1e-10))

# hot days: SST >= threshold (doy j-1 -> row)
ncell = thr.shape[1]
rows = tgt_doy - 1
sst_flat = sst_tgt.reshape(len(tgt_days), -1)[:, cells]     # (92, ncells)
hot = sst_flat >= thr_s[rows]                               # (92, ncells) sea cells only
print("hot day-cell count:", int(hot.sum()), "of", hot.size)

# per-cell: runs of >=5 hot days, join gaps of 1-2 non-hot days
T = hot.shape[0]
mhw = np.zeros_like(hot)   # (92, ncells) final per-cell MHW membership
# 1) base runs: True where part of a hot run of length >=5
runlen = np.zeros_like(hot, dtype=np.int32)
# compute run lengths per cell via forward scan
i = 0
while i < T:
    if hot[i].any():
        j = i
        while j+1 < T and hot[j+1].any():
            j += 1
        L = j - i + 1
        if L >= 5:
            runlen[i:j+1] = L
        i = j+1
    else:
        i += 1
base = runlen > 0
print("base runs (cells-days):", int(base.sum()))
# 2) join gaps: base runs separated by 1-2 non-hot days merge (transitively)
# implement by labelling base runs per cell and merging
lab = np.zeros_like(runlen)   # run labels per cell
cur = 0
i = 0
while i < T:
    if base[i].any():
        j = i
        while j+1 < T and base[j+1].any():
            j += 1
        cur += 1
        lab[i:j+1] = cur
        i = j+1
    else:
        i += 1
print("n base runs (across cells-days as segments):", cur)
# merge per cell: for each cell, walk labels
mhw_cell = np.zeros_like(hot)
for c in range(ncell):
    lc = lab[:,c]
    if lc.max() == 0:
        continue
    # find segments
    segs = []
    i = 0
    while i < T:
        if lc[i] > 0:
            j = i
            while j+1 < T and lc[j+1] > 0:
                j += 1
            segs.append([i, j])
            i = j+1
        else:
            i += 1
    # merge segments with gap 1-2
    merged = []
    for s in segs:
        if merged and (s[0] - merged[-1][1] - 1) <= 2:
            merged[-1][1] = s[1]
        else:
            merged.append(list(s))
    for a,b in merged:
        mhw_cell[a:b+1, c] = True
print("per-cell MHW cell-days after joining:", int(mhw_cell.sum()))
np.savez_compressed('/work/mhw_cells.npz', mhw_cell=mhw_cell, hot=hot, sea=sea, cells=cells,
                    tgt_days=tgt_days, thr_s=thr_s, clm_s=clm_s)
print("saved")

import numpy as np, time

z = np.load('/work/mhw_cells.npz')
hot = z['hot']            # (92, ncells) bool, sea cells only
cells = z['cells']; sea = z['sea']
tgt_days = z['tgt_days']
T, ncell = hot.shape
print("hot shape", hot.shape, "hot day-cells:", int(hot.sum()))

t0=time.time()
mhw = np.zeros_like(hot)
n_base_runs = 0
n_after_join = 0
for c in range(ncell):
    h = hot[:,c]
    if not h.any():
        continue
    # segments of consecutive hot days
    idx = np.where(h)[0]
    breaks = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[breaks+1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[breaks], idx[-1]]
    # base runs: length >= 5
    bs = starts[ (ends-starts+1) >= 5 ]
    be = ends[ (ends-starts+1) >= 5 ]
    n_base_runs += len(bs)
    if len(bs)==0:
        continue
    # join runs separated by 1-2 non-hot days (transitive)
    ms = [int(bs[0])]; me = [int(be[0])]
    for a,b in zip(bs[1:], be[1:]):
        if a - me[-1] - 1 <= 2:
            me[-1] = int(b)
        else:
            ms.append(int(a)); me.append(int(b))
    n_after_join += len(ms)
    for a,b in zip(ms,me):
        mhw[a:b+1, c] = True
print("base per-cell runs:", n_base_runs, "-> after joining:", n_after_join)
print("per-cell MHW cell-days:", int(mhw.sum()), "of", hot.size)

active = mhw.any(axis=1)    # (92,) active days
print("active days:", int(active.sum()), "of", T)
EPOCH = np.datetime64('1970-01-01','D')
tgt_dates = EPOCH + tgt_days.astype('timedelta64[D]')
# regional events: maximal runs of consecutive active days
ai = np.where(active)[0]
evs = []
if len(ai):
    br = np.where(np.diff(ai) > 1)[0]
    es = np.r_[ai[0], ai[br+1]]; ee = np.r_[ai[br], ai[-1]]
    evs = [(str(tgt_dates[a]), str(tgt_dates[b])) for a,b in zip(es,ee)]
print("regional events:")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(evs,1):
    print(f"  {i}: {a} -> {b}  ({(np.datetime64(b)-np.datetime64(a)).astype(int)+1} days)")

# per-cell MHW count and stats
percell_events = n_after_join
lens = []
for c in range(ncell):
    mi = np.where(mhw[:,c])[0]
    if len(mi)==0: continue
    br = np.where(np.diff(mi)>1)[0]
    ss = np.r_[mi[0], mi[br+1]]; ee = np.r_[mi[br], mi[-1]]
    lens += list(ee-ss+1)
lens = np.array(lens)
print("per-cell MHWs total:", len(lens), "min/median/max length:", lens.min(), np.median(lens), lens.max())
np.savez_compressed('/work/mhw_final.npz', mhw=mhw, active=active, tgt_days=tgt_days, sea=sea, cells=cells)
import json
json.dump([{"onset":a,"end":b} for a,b in evs], open('/work/events.json','w'))
print("saved mhw_final.npz and events.json")
